title: Recompilations
lead: Native PC versions of console games, rebuilt by fans from the original code.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.note: Recompilations and source ports come from the decomp-buddy and RecompLauncher catalogs and are downloaded from their projects' GitHub releases. A game with one shows an up arrow left of Play on its page. You need your own copy of the original game.

copies.title: Save copies
copies.note: PlayOut copies each recompilation's saves into a "Recompilations Saves" folder inside your Emulation folder (Settings › Library) before and after you play, and copies them back when the copy there is newer. The newer saves win; the older ones are kept as a backup on this PC. When both changed, you pick. The Emulation folder is shared with your other PCs by PlayOut's streaming, so your saves follow you.
